selection_basis: Fixed before language outputs; basic sensory examples, two paraphrases, chemical proxy examples, missing-coverage and zero-rate edge cases, and controlled memory probes.
duration_policy: Every accepted plan is clamped to 250 ms; original planner duration remains in the trace. This duration intervention is not credited to the planner.
memory_query_policy: For controlled_memory_query only, retain the raw planner output then explicitly replace inputs with the specified exact DoOR chemical, scale 1, no reinforcement, no catalog stimuli/channels. Naive/A/B condition labels and source learning logs are never given to planner or narrator. These cases assess narration/reader response to memory, not planner accuracy.
annotation: Raw material for human fidelity annotation; successful execution is not a claim of accurate language or biological behavior.
